reference_change.summary: Use hmac.compare_digest instead of == in src/auth.py, and add tests for matching and mismatching ASCII tokens.
reference_change.rationale: Ordinary equality may reveal the first differing position through timing; token validation should avoid that comparison leak.
reference_change.limitations: The contract still requires ASCII strings of the supported type; this does not protect unrelated authentication logic or network timing.
reference_change.breaking_changes: None for supported ASCII tokens; unsupported token types are outside the contract.
